copy.headline: Save Muny deal sparks concerns about future of Austin research lab
copy.caption: A proposed agreement to permanently preserve Lions Municipal Golf Course is drawing concern from researchers who say it could leave Austin's Brackenridge Field Lab vulnerable to future development.
